chunks: Verily the pious will be in heaven,

key_terms.الْأَبْرَارَ: The pious or righteous ones, plural of barr

ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate fate of the righteous (al-abrar) according to Surah al-Mutaffifin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-abrar* as those who fulfill their vows and maintain piety, with some traditions identifying them specifically with the Ahl al-Bayt or the faithful who uphold justice against the *mutaffifin*. The term *na'im* signifies not only eternal bliss but also a state of spiritual contentment derived from divine proximity, contrasting sharply with the worldly deception of the defrauders. This highlights the eschatological reward for those who practice *adl* (justice) in both measurement and moral conduct.
